[CR CR2400r1 for 38.133] Reason for change: To correct PRS measurement requirements in RRC inactive state Summary of change: Several remaining issues related to PRS measurement requirements in RRC inactive state are updated or aligned between different types of PRS measurements based on LPP signalling/capabilities defined in TS 37.355. These aspects include: Rx beam sweeping factor Reduced number of samples Rx TEG for RSTD RxTx TEG for UE Rx-Tx time difference RRC state transition from RRC_INACTIVE to RRC_CONNECTED for RSTD Consequences if not approved: PRS measurement requirements in RRC inactive will be incomplete and/or some aspects may remain ambiguous.
